title: [Attention][Feature] Support C8 MXFP8 KV cache quantization in Ascend v2 worker
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
This pull request implements support for C8 MXFP8 KV cache quantization in the Ascend v2 worker. Specifically, it:
- Rewrites `FullAttentionSpec` to `mxfp_cache_spec` when MXFP8 KV quantization is enabled.
- Implements `_reshape_kv_cache_v2` to build appropriate views for MXFP8 caches.
- Adds initialization and management of static V scale caches (`_fill_c8_mxfp_v_scale_caches`) and restores them during page reassignment in `update_requests`.
- Integrates `AscendKVBlockZeroer` to handle zeroing of MXFP8 KV blocks while preserving static V scales.

Feedback on this PR suggests adding defensive checks in `_fill_c8_mxfp_v_scale_caches` to avoid potential `ZeroDivisionError` and `IndexError` when `num_blocks` is 0 or `kv_cache` is malformed, as well as safely retrieving `static_forward_context` in `_init_kv_zero_meta` to prevent `AttributeError`.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No, this is an internal enablement of MXFP8 KV cache quantization for Ascend NPU backends.

### How was this patch tested?
New unit tests have been added in `tests/ut/worker/test_attn_utils_v2.py` and `tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v2.py` to verify the MXFP8 spec rewriting, cache reshaping, V-scale filling, and zeroing logic.
